C1565.title: Axios Supply Chain Poisoning: Compromised Front-End HTTP Library Propagates Malicious Code via Dependency Chain
C1565.summary: In April 2026, China National Cybersecurity Bulletin Center warned that JavaScript HTTP library Axios had suffered a supply-chain poisoning attack. Related malicious code commonly uses obfuscation, self-deletion, anti-debugging, and similar techniques, can trigger risk in the supply-chain process, and may cause credential theft, remote code execution, and other harms. Because Axios is directly depended on by many AI applications and plugin ecosystems, malicious code spreading through the dependency chain can create broad sensitive data leakage risk and amplify trust problems in frontend builds, plugin installation, and automated deployment pipelines.
